name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.18: a screen-poster editor, so ads stop being a console-only field. Ads were already served in config and validated on the backend, but there was no dashboard UI and no way to host an image for them, leaving it a hand-written PUT. The machine Overview now has a screen poster panel: upload an image, set how many seconds it shows, add optional overlay text, reorder or remove, and a toggle for whether the poster area appears on the screen at all. Adds POST /machines/:deviceCode/ads/upload which hosts the file on R2 and checks it against the kiosk ad region, which is HD landscape 16:9 — a poster off that ratio is reported back as croppable rather than silently accepted, and anything wider than 1920px is re-encoded down since the extra bytes cross a machine connection for no visible gain. Changes reach the machine at its next config poll, with no app update. Cumulative over v6.17.1.
